name: meeting-playbook
description: Personal AI meeting assistant — pre/in/post-meeting playbook, transcription, tactical advisor, summary.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,auth,backend,asr -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "bun --filter @meeting-playbook/web dev" "bun --filter @meeting-playbook/auth dev" "cd packages/backend && uv run uvicorn meeting_playbook.server:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" "cd packages/asr-runtime && uv run uvicorn meeting_playbook_asr_runtime.server:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port ${ASR_RUNTIME_PORT:-8100}"
scripts.lint: concurrently "bun --filter '*' lint" "cd packages/backend && uv run ruff check" "cd packages/asr-runtime && uv run ruff check"
scripts.format: concurrently "bun --filter '*' format" "cd packages/backend && uv run ruff format" "cd packages/asr-runtime && uv run ruff format"
scripts.test: concurrently "bun --filter '*' test" "cd packages/backend && uv run pytest" "cd packages/asr-runtime && uv run pytest"
